name: What documents do I need for a pool demolition permit application?

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need for a pool demolition permit application in Los Angeles-area cities?
mainEntity.text: What documents do I need for a pool demolition permit application in Los Angeles-area cities?

acceptedAnswer.text: The permit package usually starts with the property address, owner or contractor details, and a site plan that shows the pool, structures, and property lines. Depending on the city, the application may also need utility disconnect details, grading information, and soils-related documents if the lot will be filled or built on later. Some jurisdictions ask for photos to clarify the existing condition or to verify that the pool is not near a boundary issue. The most common reason for delays is missing or unclear documentation. Before filing, the contractor should confirm whether the city wants a simple plan set or a more detailed submittal with engineering support. A complete package usually moves faster and avoids correction notices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical documents include a site or plot plan, property address details, contractor or owner information, and any required utility, grading, or engineering attachments. Some cities also want photos and a demolition description before issuing the permit.
